introduction.p: In each expression, how many negative signs and subtraction signs are there?

statement.p: 1-9 has negative signs and subtraction signs.

solution.p: 1-9 has zero negative signs and one subtraction sign.

statement.p: -12+(-50) has negative signs and subtraction signs.

solution.p: -12+(-50) has two negative signs and zero subtraction signs.

statement.p: \dfrac{-13-(-15)-17}{23-4} has negative signs and subtraction signs.

solution.p: \dfrac{-13-(-15)-17}{23-4} has two negative signs and three subtraction signs.
